row: Scenic City Clinic of Chiropractic and Nutrition

Welcome to the official YouTube channel of Scenic City Clinic, where chiropractic care meets modern wellness. Our mission is simple: help you move better, feel better, and live healthier—naturally.

On this channel, you’ll find:

Upper Cervical Chiropractic education & treatment explanations
Nutritional Testing "Whys" and Information
IHT Bioscan explanations
Softwave TRT testimonials
Red light therapy & recovery science
Wellness tips for wellness, mobility, and longevity
Behind-the-scenes looks at our clinic and technology
Evidence-based approaches to whole-body health

Whether you’re dealing with pain, chronic health, athletic wear and tear, looking to optimize your health, or curious about advanced therapies like full-body red light therapy, our videos are designed to educate, empower, and support your healing journey.

📍 Located in Chattanooga, TN
💡 Focused on results-driven, patient-centered care
